text_block_list.text:
It's been a while, Trainer! I've been
lonely without
you!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Duh! I had a ton of fun playing during
my time
off, but...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, I'd realize that you weren't
there...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
So! I'm going to stick with you like glue
to make
up for all the lost time! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: It looks like Maya got plenty of rest over her break. In fact, she's almost too lively.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
